Target file after the patch:
## Tasks / Subtasks

- [x] Extract the current one-shot response preparation/render path into a dedicated render actor/machine (AC: 2)
  - [x] Preserve the existing prepare → deterministic text → optional LLM → draft assembly pipeline as a focused render-only unit.
  - [x] Keep the current prepared/failed output contract available to root/supervisor consumers so non-create rendering does not regress.
  - [x] Do not mix create-dialogue lifecycle state into the render actor.

- [x] Promote `responsemachine` into a supervisor/router role (AC: 1, 2)
  - [x] Refactor `responsemachine.ts` so its top-level responsibility is child supervision and routing, not direct ownership of the full one-shot render pipeline.
  - [x] Add routing logic that can choose between the render actor path and the flow-keyed create-dialogue path based on workflow context.
  - [x] Keep the supervisor typed and explicit; avoid a monolithic context that blends render-only fields with long-lived dialogue state.

- [x] Add the structural create-dialogue child surface under response supervision (AC: 1)
  - [x] Introduce a dedicated `createDialogueMachine(flowId)` child contract or scaffold under the response supervisor.
  - [x] Keep the child keyed by `flowId` and architected for resume/rehydration from root-owned workflow state.
  - [x] In this story, establish the supervision boundary and lifecycle slot only; deeper dialogue behavior belongs to later stories.

- [x] Update root-to-response wiring to target the supervisor abstraction cleanly (AC: 1, 2)
  - [x] Extend the root → response input contract as needed so the supervisor can distinguish ordinary render requests from active create-flow dialogue supervision.
  - [x] Preserve the existing non-create response path from `chatsendrootmachinev2.ts` so current routed responses still render through the dedicated render actor.
  - [x] Keep root as the durable orchestration boundary; response supervision should not become the new owner of workflow truth.

- [x] Isolate current response-layer technical debt instead of expanding it (AC: 1, 2)
  - [x] If the current direct OpenAI invocation remains temporarily necessary, confine it to the render actor path rather than spreading it into supervisor/dialogue orchestration.

- [ ] Remediate response-template payload/schema drift in the render path (AC: 2)
  - [ ] Align `existing_field_candidates` payloads with `response-template-registry.ts` validation requirements.
  - [ ] Align `lookup_entity_relation_result` payloads with `response-template-registry.ts` validation requirements.

- [ ] Preserve child failure detail when the render actor fails (AC: 2)
  - [ ] Surface the actual child error from `response-render-machine.ts` instead of collapsing it to a generic supervisor failure.

- [ ] Fail closed on create-dialogue hydration and flow selection (AC: 1)
  - [ ] Require unambiguous active-create selection before binding `createDialogueMachine(flowId)`.
  - [ ] Reject incomplete resume payloads instead of treating fallback hydration as a successful child recovery.
  - [x] Do not widen the legacy one-shot `generated_entity_creation` rendering semantics to stand in for full create dialogue.
  - [x] Keep template/payload normalization changes minimal unless required to support the render/supervisor split.



- [patch] `response-spec-builders.ts` and `response-template-registry.ts` are out of sync for multiple render branches. The `existing_field_candidates` and `lookup_entity_relation_result` paths emit payload shapes that do not satisfy the registry schemas, so those branches will fail validation when reached.
- [patch] `responsemachine.ts` loses the child error detail when `response-render-machine.ts` returns a failed output. The supervisor reads `event.error`, but the render path reports the failure in `output.error`, which collapses the root cause to a generic `response_supervisor_failed` error.
- [patch] The create-dialogue branch can bind the wrong `flowId` or treat incomplete hydration as success when resume data is missing or ambiguous. This should fail closed so the supervisor never reports a recovered child unless the payload is actually complete.
- [defer] `createDialogueMachine(flowId)` is still only a structural scaffold in this story. Deeper conversational behavior is intentionally deferred to later stories and should not be treated as a Story 2.1 defect.
